Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The umpires and the players are back out in the middle. Regis Chakabva and the debutant Innocent Kaia are all set to open the innings for Zimbabwe. Fazalhaq Farooqi has the new ball in hand and is raring to go.
... The Run Chase ...

It is a painful end to the Zimbabwe innings. Their bowlers were on the money from the word go. The pacers were certainly dictating the terms and made the most of the conditions on offer. They had restricted the runflow as well. Although they could not build on the two early wickets, as they got derailed in the middle overs. Blessing Muzarabani tried to get his side back in the game but it was a little too late. He was the star with the ball with his four-fer. Also, Tanaka Chivanga took a wicket on his debut. Nevertheless, it was a forgetful outing for the rest of the bowling pack. The onus now is on the batters to chase down the target and take a lead in this series on their home turf. It won't be an easy task though. Do join us shortly for the second essay to find out how things pan out.

It could've gone all wrong for Afghanistan but the skipper made sure that was not the case. Afghanistan were off to a steady start, and were left teetering at 38/2 at one stage. The ship had started to sink but their third wicket-stand managed to do all the repair work. Shah and Shahidi stitched a stand of 181 runs to get their side to safer shores. They had built a foundation for the lower-order to come in and do their job in the death overs. Although, it did not go as per plan as they kept losing wickets in cluster once this stand was broken. In the end, Rashid Khan displayed his batting skills and with his quickfire 17-ball 39 helped his side to rack up 101 in the last 10 overs. The visiting side go back to the dressing room with the momenum on their side.

An incredbible game of cricket so far! At first it looked like the home side would dominate the proceedings throughout the innings but Afghanistan batters fought back with grit and determination to set up a target of 277 in the end.

FOUR! What a way to finish and 19 runs come off the final over! This is angled into middle and leg, Rashid Khan sits down and just laps it over short fine leg for a boundary. Afghanistan end with 276/5!
This is banged in short over off. Khan with a hook shot this time towards deep mid-wicket and once again he races back for the second.

FOUR! This is some brilliant batting from Rashid Khan. A low full toss on off, Khan with another short-arm jab. The ball goes well in front of square on the leg side and beats the fielder running around from deep mid-wicket.

Good running but that's sloppy from Zimbabwe. Short ball around off, Khan with a nonchalant helicopter shot on the bounce to deep mid-wicket. The batters race back for the second and the fielder in the deep is slow to get the throw in. Easy two in the end.

SIX! Oh boy, Rashid Khan is in the mood here! Poor delivery from Tendai Chatara, slower delivery just on a length and around off. Khan picks it up and whacks it over the mid-wicket fence for a huge hit.
1 run.
Fuller and slower outside off. Khan stays leg side of the ball and looks to slog it away but gets undone by the lack of pace.

Tough chance put down! Slower delivery, back of a length and outside off. Rashid Khan throws his hands at it and gets a top edge over the point region. Craig Ervine back peddles and does well to attempt the catch over his shoulders but puts it down. Two taken.
SIX! BOOM! Full and straight, Muzarabani just about misses his length. Rashid Khan hangs deep and smokes it over the long on fence for a biggie.

FOUR! Streaky boundary but Rashid Khan will take it. Another slower ball, over middle. Khan gets low and has a swipe across the line. The ball comes off the top edge and goes over backward square leg to run away into the fence.
Short ball now, outside off. Khan looks to fetch it and pull it through mid-wicket but gets a bottom edge back onto the deck.
How has that missed? Very full from Muzarabani but it is the slower delivery. Rashid Khan has a big swing at it but misses and the ball misses the leg stump by a whisker.
Slower delivery around off, Khan pushes it towards wide mid on for a single.
Good comeback by Tendai Chatara. A well-directed bumper over middle and leg. Khan takes his eyes off the ball as he looks to hook it away but is beaten.
FOUR! Powerful hit! Short of a length, outside off. Rashid Khan hits it on the up and pierces the gap at extra cover for a boundary.
Two more! Fuller and angled into leg stump, Khan clips it past square leg and picks up a couple of runs.
Brilliant running! Full and straight, Khan drives it through wide mid on and calls for two straightaway. Zadran responds and races back with time to spare.
Chatara starts the over off with a bouncer over off. Rashid Khan looks to help it on its way but gets beaten.
Ooh, a bit of aggression now from Blessing Muzarabani! A spicy short ball over middle and leg, Najibullah Zadran just about manages to get his head out of the way.
Slower delivery, on off. Zadran looks to cut but has to check his shot and just about manages to keep it out.
Length, on middle. Zadran edges it down with soft hands towards third man. The call is for two and the batters get it with ease.
Rashid Khan comes in at number 7.

OUT! TAKEN A second wicket in the over for Blessing Muzarabani and he is single-handedly pulling Zimbabwe back into the game. Length delivery around off. Mohammad Nabi hangs deep in his crease and looks to lift it over extra cover but mistimes it towards the cover region. Milton Shumba comes charging in from the deep and slides in to take a really good catch. Muzarabani has his fourth and Afghanistan losing the plot a bit.
Commentary.Howout: c Milton Shumba b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length, around off. Mohammad Nabi opens the face of the bat and guides it off the back foot through point for a couple of runs.
Najibullah Zadran is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Blessing Muzarabani gets his third wicket and he has now dismissed both the set-batters at a very crucial stage of the innings. This is fuller and outside off, Shahidi makes room again looking to launch it straight back but gets a thick outside edge on it. The pace of the ball takes it towards the third man fence where Donald Tiripano takes a good catch. Hashmatullah Shahidi falls short of his century too and Afghanistan lose their fourth.
Commentary.Howout: c Donald Tiripano b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: Around the hips, this is tucked away past backward square leg for one.

FOUR! Shahidi pre-meditates and shuffles right across the stumps. Chatara goes wider but Shahidi just about manages to get some bat on it. The ball flies past the keeper and runs away into the third man fence.

Just short! Another slower delivery from Chatara, over middle and angling across. Hashmatullah Shahidi looks to cut close to the body but gloves it. The ball lands in front of Regis Chakabva who dives to his left and pouches it on the bounce.
Slower and into the pitch, over middle. Nabi nudges it past square leg and turns the strike over.
Another slower delivery, bowled into the pitch. Nabi works it behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Slower delivery, a bit too straight. Mohammad Nabi shuffles across and tickles it fine past short fine leg for a boundary.
Back of a length, on off, Shahidi leans back and tries to ramp it over the keeper's head but misses.

In the air...but safe! It is a short ball, a slower one, wide outside off. Mohammad Nabi jumps to cut it away and gets it to lob off the toe-end. It lands safely and he gets off the mark with a single.
Aggressive from Blessing Muzarabani. It is a sharp bouncer, on off. Mohammad Nabi ducks under it.
Mohammad Nabi comes in at number 5.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Blessing Muzarabani picks up his second wicket and breaks a crucial partnership this time. It is a length ball that lands outside off and nips back in sharply. Shah tries to fend it away but gets an inside edge. Regis Chakabva does a brilliant job behind the sticks to make a full-stretched dive to his left and gather the ball. Brilliants innings from Rahmat Shah but he misses out on a century.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Up and over! A short ball, wide outside off. Shah shuffles across and hammers it over covers for a cracking boundary. He moves to 94 now.
Play and a miss! A length ball, outside off. Shah tries to cut it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Tossed up, on the stumps. Shah inside-edges it to square leg for a single. 12 runs off the over.
On the pads, Shahidi clips it to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! The skipper is not here to sit back. It is full and on off. Hashmatullah Shahidi gets low and reverse-sweeps it over point for a boundary.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Hashmatullah Shahidi tries to sweep it away but misses.

Overthrows! It is full, on middle and leg. Shah clips it to square leg for a single. The batters call for a couple. The throw comes in like fire, misses the stumps and races away to the fence at wide long off. They get six runs off it. Although, the umpires have a look and confirm they will only get five as the batters didn't cross for the second run when the throw left the arm of the fielder.

NOT OUT! Leg bye! It is arm ball, angled down leg. Shahidi tries to hit it across the line but misses. He gets pinged on his pads. Raza appeals but the umpire is unmoved. Zimbabwe opt for a review but it does not go their way as the replays show the ball is missing the wickets. The batters collect a leg bye.

Review! Zimbabwe seem desperate for a wicket and have taken the review for an lbw decision. The third umpire checks Ultra Edge and there's clearly no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows that the impact is in line with the leg stump but the ball is missing the leg stump. The on-field decision of NOT OUT stands!
A slower length ball, angled down leg. Shahidi tickles it to the right of the keeper. Regis Chakabva moves to that side and gathers the ball on a bounce. They take one.
Length ball, on off, defended out.
Length ball, outside off. Shah dabs it down to point for a single.
SIX! All the way! Rahmat Shah dances down the track and turns it into a full delivery to smack it over the bowler's head for a biggie over the long on fence.
Short again, wide outside off. Shah goes hunting but is unable to press the trigger.
Back of a length, on off. Shah hangs back and cuts it to deep backward point. They take two runs.
On off, pushed out to mid off.
FOUR! Nicely played. It is a googly, full and on off. Hashmatullah Shahidi reverse-sweeps it down to third man for a boundary.
TWO WIDES! It is looped up and angled down leg. Shah fails to pick it up and also the keeper. The batters sneak in a single.
Raza continues to go shorter, outside off. Shahidi now slaps it through point for a single.
A short ball, wide outside off. Shahidi tries to cut it away but misses.
Angled into the pads, Shahidi flicks it through square leg for a brace.
Looped up, full and outside off. Shahidi tries to chase it but misses.
Sikandar Raza (5-0-24-0) to continue.
Full, on off. Shah comes down the track and hits it to cover but the fielder does well to stop it.
FOUR! In the gap this time. A short ball, on off. Shah stays back and pulls it into the gap at deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full length, wide outside off. Shahidi slashes it to sweeper cover for a run.
A slower, full-length delivery, on off. Shahidi defends it out.
Length ball, angled across the left-handed batsman. Shahidi tries to chase it but misses.
FOUR! Tanaka Chivanga is getting a taste of ODI cricket here. A short ball, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi plays it late and guides it down to third man for a boundary.
End of Powerplay 2! Now the fielding side can have up to five fielders outside the 30-yard circle.
Tossed up, on the middle stump. Shah makes room and punches it through covers.
On off, defended to point.
FOUR! Cracking shot! It is a length ball, outside off. Shah makes room and cuts it through covers for a boundary.
Touch short and on off. Shahidi dabs it to backward point for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Hashmatullah Shahidi is on the charge now. It is fuller, on off yet again. Hashmatullah Shahidi sweeps it through mid-wicket for another boundary.
FOUR! A boundary of the first ball and the pressure is on the bowler straight away. It is full and on off. Hashmatullah Shahidi gets low and slog-sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Easy pickings for the batters! Too staright and too full, on the pads. Shah hangs back and flicks it through fine leg for a boundary. An expensive over for Tanaka Chivanga, 12 runs off it.
A good comeback delivery by Tanaka Chivanga. This is a length ball, wide outside off, shapes in a touch. Shah tries to drive it away but misses.
SIX! BOOM! Shah goes downtown this time. It is overpitched, on off. Shah expands his arms and fires it over the long on fence for a biggie.
A sharp bouncer this time, on off. Shah bends his knees and leaves it alone.
Good-length ball, on top of off. Shahidi waits for it and dabs it down to third man for another single.
Tanaka Chivanga starts by hitting the hard length and shapes it into the batter. Shah stays back and tucks it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
A bit of pace now as Tanaka Chivanga is brought back into the attack.
Flatter and on the stumps. Shah goes back and clips it through mid-wicket for another single. A tidy over by Raza comes to an end.
A single now as this is worked through mid on.
On off, blocked out.
Flatter and on off. Shah flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Shah sweeps it to deep square leg for a brace.
Tossed up, on the stumps. Shah defends it back to the bowler on the front foot.

FOUR! Just what the doctor called for. It is full and on off. Shahidi frees his arms and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary. We should certainly see more of this as we head into the death overs.
Looped up, on off, defended out.
On off, punched to cover for one.
Flatter and on the pads, Hashmatullah Shahidi goes back and tucks it to square leg for a single. The skipper now reaches the fifty-run mark. A captain's knock from him.
Looped up, on middle and leg. Hashmatullah Shahidi defends it to the leg side.
Tossed up, full and on off. Shah drives it to the off side for a single.
An arm ball, outside off. Shahidi looks to chase it but misses.
FIFTY FOR SHAH! A game-savings innings from him. This is darted on the pads, Shah tucks it to mid-wicket for a single. He raises his blade in appreciation but he knows his job is only half done now.
On off, defended out.
Fuller and on the pads, Hashmatullah Shahidi eases it to long on for a single.
On off, blocked out.
Looped up, on off, this one turns in. Shah tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.

DRINKS! The current Afghanistan pair has certainly done the repair work with the 97 runs. Both would look to step on the gas once they have racked up their fifties. Zimbabwe have been good with the ball so far but haven't been able to trouble the batter in the middle phase. The home side would hope to take a couple more wickets and get their noses in front.
Beaten! Fuller and around off, this one turns away from the left-hander. Shahidi looks to cut but is beaten past the outside edge.
Loopy delivery around off, Shahidi presses forward to defend.
On off, defended away by Shahidi.
Brilliant fielding from Milton Shumba. Length, down leg, Shah just glances it fine but Shumba dives to his right to make a half stop at short fine leg. Just the single then.
Around middle and leg, Hashmatullah Shahidi steps out and pushes it down to long on for a run.
Tossed up around off, this is driven through extra cover for a single.
Around middle and leg, flicked away to square leg.
Not much happening in the game at the moment and something's got to give here. On middle, blocked out.
Raza shortens the length and bowls it on middle. Rahmat Shah just turns it through mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Fuller this time, Shah drives it towards covers.
Over middle, this is flicked away through square leg for a single.
Bye! Quicker and shorter around off. Rahmat Shah looks to cut but gets beaten due to the additional bounce. The keeper fails to collect the ball and a single is taken.
At the stumps, blocked out.
Flighted this time, on the pads. Hashmatullah Shahidi looks to flick it leg side but gets a leading edge. The ball loops up but falls well short of the bowler.
Shorter again and around off. This is worked off the back foot through covers for a single.
Around off, punched off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a run.
Around off, this is driven with the spin towards deep extra cover for one more.
Tossed up full and on middle, Hashmatullah Shahidi flicks it towards mid-wicket where the fielder makes a half stop to his right. The batters cross for one.
On a shorter length and around off, Shah fails to get it away. Tidy start from Raza, just a single off it.
On middle, Shah flicks it straight towards square leg.

Half an appeal from the bowler but it is turned down. Shorter but slower thsi time and on middle. Shah looks to work it leg side but gets hit on the pads. The ball might have just taken the inside edge as well.
Short ball on off, Shahidi nudges it towards mid-wicket and picks up an easy single.
Flatter and on off, tapped towards the cover region.
Starts off with a quicker delivery around off. The ball turns away sharply as Shahidi is well beaten.
Sikandar Raza to have a bowl now.
On the pads, this is tucked away 'round the corner for a single.
On off, Shahidi puts a big stride forward to block it out.

Put down! Tossed up around off and turning away. Rahmat Shah with a lovely inside-out shot towards wide long off. Wesley Madhevere runs to his left and gets there with time to spare but ends up grassing it. Single taken.
Gives it a bit more air, Shah looks to come forward but checks his shot in the end.
This is pushed through on middle and leg, Shah goes deep in his crease to keep it out.
Shorter in length and turning away, Shah taps it towards covers.
Length and on middle, Shahidi defends it from inside his crease.
FOUR! Flatter delivery around off, Hashmatullah Shahidi waits for it and cuts it really late, beating the man at short third man. Shahidi picks up a boundary.
A bit quicker and around off. Shahidi defends it out on the off side.
On middle, blocked out.
Shorter and on middle, Shah turns it through mid-wicket for a run.
On off, stroked away through covers for a single.

Was that dropped? Flighted delivery on middle, Rahmat Shah tries the cheeky reverse sweep but mistimes it a bit aerially. The fielder at first slip is quick to read the direction of the shot and goes for the catch low to his right but misses. That one might have just dropped in front of him. The replay shows that it just about carried so that is a dropped catch from the skipper.
This is drifted into middle, Shah leans forward and defends it out.
Quicker and flatter on middle. Shah manages to keep it out.
Here comes the googly, outside off and Hashmatullah Shahidi just strokes it past point for one.
Loopy delivery around off, Shahidi strides forward and keeps it out on the off side.
Tossed up outside off, Shah drives it with the spin towards deep cover for a single.
This is speared into middle, Shahidi keeps it out.
Fuller and on middle, pushed down to long on for one.
On off, punched back towards the bowler.
Tad shorter and turning away, Shahidi plays it with the turn to deep point and picks up a run.
On off, Shahidi defends it out.
Shorter and around off, punched off the back foot but straight to cover.
FOUR! Short and punished! This is dragged down on middle, Rahmat Shah waits for it and thumps it into the wide long on fence.
Shouts of 'Catch it,' but the ball lands safely. Drifted onto middle and just turning away. Shah looks to flick it leg side but gets a leading edge towards the cover region.
Slower through the air and on the pads, Shah nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Shorter and around off, played off the back foot through covers for a single.
Nicely bowled! This is pushed wider, Shahidi looks to defend it out but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Burl starts off with a very full delivery on off. Shah drives it towards long off for a single.
Shorter, on off. This is eased off the back foot down to long on for a single.
Shah tries to be cheeky but it doesn't come off. Around off, Rahmat Shah brings out the reverse sweep but can't get past the man at short fine leg.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed towards mid on.
On middle and leg, blocked out by Shah.
Rahmat Shah getting a bit troubled at the moment. Flighted around off, Shah looks to turn it leg side but gets a leading edge that falls safely to the left of the bowler.
Half an appeal! This is tossed up full and around off, Shah misses the drive and gets pinged on the pads. The impact seemed to be outside off though.
FOUR! Cracked! A short ball, wide outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi stands back and cuts it through point for a fine boundary.
Length, on off, blocked out watchfully.
A sharp bouncer, on the bodyline. Shahidi leaves it alone.
Full length, on off. Shah drives it to extra cover for a quick single.

FOUR BYES! Misses everything! A beautiful delivery but not the result it deserves. A length ball, pitched wide outside off. This one shapes in a long way off the seam. Rahmat Shah throws his blade at it but gets beaten on the inside edge. It scoots past the stumps and the even the keeper fails to grab it. The ball races away to the fine leg fence.
Length ball, on off, defended out.
Floated and full, outside off. Shah uses his feet and drives it through covers for a single.
On middle, Shah blocks it to the right of the bowler.
Flatter and on off. Shahidi dabs it to backward point and scampers through for a single.
Fuller, on off, Shah eases it to covers for a single.
Flatter and outside off, Shahidi punches it to cover for one.
On off, defended out.
A sharp bouncer this time, on middle and leg. Rahmat Shah tries to hook it away but misses.
Full length, around off. Shah stabs it to covers.
On a length, on off, Shah blocks it out to cover.
A length ball, outside off. Shah hangs back and punches it to cover but unable to get it in the gap.
Full length, outside off. Shah drives it to cover but straight to the fielder.
Back of a length, outside off, Shahidi dabs it down to third man for a single.
Shorter delivery well outside off, Rahmat Shah waits for it and cuts it behind point for a couple of runs.
Flatter delivery outside off, this is cut away towards deep point for a run.
Around middle and leg, this is worked away past square leg for one more. The fifty partnership is up between these two.
A tad shorter, on leg stump. Shahidi turns it through square leg for a single.
Length, on middle, Shahidi keeps it out.
Flatter and on off, Shahidi nudges it towards point and looks for a quick single but is sent back.
Short ball, angled across, Shahidi works it down to third man for a single.
Outside off, left alone.
Good length, on off, blocked out.
WIDE! Full and wide outside off, Shahidi does not chase it and the umpire deems it as a wide.
This one lands on middle and leg, shapes away from the batter and Shahidi lets it be.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Slapped! A low full toss, wide outside off. Shahidi leans in and drives it through covers for a boundary.
This is angled down leg, Hashmatullah Shahidi just tickles it 'round the corner and picks up a run.
This is speared into off, Shahidi leans forward to defend it out.
On middle and leg, Shah backs away and knocks it down to long on for one more.
Flatter again, around off. This is played off the back foot through cover-point for a single.
Quicker and fuller around off, Rahmat Shah drives it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Madhevere starts off with a flatter delivery outside off. Shah punches it off the back foot towards the bowler.
Pitched up in that channel around off and Hashmatullah Shahidi leaves it alone.
Fuller and on off, Shahidi defends it out.
Around the hips, tucked away past square leg for a single.
Length again, around off. Shah looks to force it through the cover region but mistimes it badly.

Well bowled! Chivanga angles this one into the off stump from wide of the crease. The ball just straightens a bit as the outside edge is found. The ball lands well in front of the man at first slip though.
On a good length around off. Shah defends it out on the off side.

No wide called and Hashmatullah Shahidi doesn't look impressed. Very full and outside the tramline past the off stump. Shahidi misses the shot and the umpire signals that the bowler was in his eye line and hence his vision was blocked.
WIDE! Free hit to continue! Tiripano digs in a slower bumper outside off but it is just a bit too high.
NO BALL! A length ball, very close to the off stump and Shahidi makes a watchful leave. No ball called for overstepping and a Free hit will follow.
Length this time, trying to angle it in but it is a fair bit outside off. Easy leave for Shahidi.
Full and wide, a bit of extra pace behind that one. Shahidi looks to drive but is well beaten.
Length, around off. Shahidi presses forward and taps it towards cover.
FOUR! Easily done! A half-volley around off, Hashmatullah Shahidi leans into the shot and drives it through cover-point for a boundary.
Tiripano comes from around the wicket and angles it into middle. A bit of an extra bounce as Hashmatullah Shahidi gets cramped for room and gets hit in the ribs.
Fuller in length, angled into middle and leg. Shah keeps it out towards mid on.
Pitched up around off, nice drive off the front foot by Rahmat Shah but straight to the man at mid off.
Length again, outside off. Shah doesn't play at it.
Around the top of off, Shahidi hangs back and edges it down with soft hands through backward point for one.
Lovely delivery! Length ball on off and just angling across the batter. Hashmatullah Shahidi gets all squared up as he tries to fend it away but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Short and wide, Shahidi taps it through covers and comes back for the second with ease.

Edged and four Good length, angling into off. Rahmat Shah takes a step forward and looks to flick it leg side but gets a thick outside edge that flies past first slip and runs away into the third man fence.
Length again, outside off. Shah lets it through to the keeper.
WIDE! Length ball, right on the tramline outside off. The umpire deems it a wide.
Fullish length on off, Shah punches it off the front foot towards extra cover.
Fuller, on middle and leg. This is driven without much timing towards mid on.
Much better from Tiripano. Length, around the top of off. Shah solidly defends it out.

Too full and too straight from Tiripano first up. Hashmatullah Shahidi works it through square leg. The fielder from deep backward square leg runs around and keeps it down to three runs. Good running.

DRINKS! It has been a good start from the Zimbabwean pacers and they have made full use of the helpful conditions. Afghanistan have lost both their openers but slowly and steadily they are getting back into the game. The run rate is low but they will be hoping to do the repair work in the middle phase. Zimbabwe will look to continue picking up wickets and keep the scoring rate in check. Also, Donald Tiripano comes into the attack now.
This one comes in from off. Shah pushes it to cover but not in the gap. Five dots in a row to end the over.
Another fantastic delivery by Tanaka Chivanga. Shah decided to defend this length ball, on the fourth stump line. Shah fails to do so and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length ball, outside off, shaping in a touch. Shah shoulders his arms at it.
A length ball, on the fourth stump line. Shah leaves it alone.
A short ball, on middle and leg. Shah defends it to the leg side.

SIX! BANG! Rahmat Shah uses the pace of the bowler this time. It is full and angled down leg. Shah stays back and flicks it over the square leg fence for a maximum. It is a brilliant shot and Shah made it look so easy.
Length, on off, blocked out. Only 5 runs off the over.
Full length, on off. Shah gets on the front foot and drives it through the cover region for three runs.
Angled in, full and on middle. Shah gets his blade down in time to work it back to the bowler.
Play and a miss! Good length, outside off, shaping away a hint. Shah tries to punch it away but gets beaten.
Good length, wide outside off. Shah leaves it alone.
In the air...safe! Back of a length, wide outside off. Shah stays back and cuts it aerially through point. It lands safely and the batters collect a brace.
Good length, angled across the left-hander. Shahidi lets it be.
Wide outside off, left alone by Shahidi.

FOUR! Shahidi gets lucky this time. It is a length ball, that lands on off and nips in a touch. Hashmatullah Shahidi tries to leave the ball, but it goes past the keeper off the back of the blade. Four more for Afghanistan.
Quicker, angled across the left-handed batsman. Shahidi only watches it sail past him.
FOUR! Nicely played! A length ball, angled down leg. Hashmatullah Shahidi tickles it down to fine leg for a boundary.
A length ball, around off, angled across the left hander. Shahidi leaves it alone.
Another one outside off, left alone.
It is touch slower, on a length, wide outside off and moving away. After three play and a miss. Rahmat Shah does not go after this one.
Four dots on the trot! Full length, wide outside off, shaping away. Shah tries to drive it on his front foot but fails to get any bat on it.
Another beauty! Swing and a miss yet again! Full length, outside off, shaping away a hint. Shah tries to defend it out but gets beaten.
BEATEN! A length ball, on the fifth stump line. Shah shuffles across and tries to defend it inside the line but misses.
Short ball, outside off. Shah cuts it to point.
Tendai Chatara to continue his first spell. So far he has figures of, 5-1-16-0.
A wicket-taking over by Tanaka Chivanga comes to an end. A length ball, on middle and leg, blocked out.
WIDE! Length ball, wide outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi leaves it alone. Wide called.
The skipper, Hashmatullah Shahidi walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Tanaka Chivanga strikes in his very first over on debut to get rid of Gurbaz! It is a short ball, angling away, outside off. Gurbaz flirts with it away from his body only to get a thick outside edge. Craig Ervine takes a sharp catch in the slips. Zimbabwe are right on top at the moment.
Commentary.Howout: c Craig Ervine b Tanaka Chivanga

Commentary.Commentary: Good length, angled into the pads, this is quicker as well. Gurbaz tucks it through backward square leg for a single. It could've been two but they ran a run short.
On a length, wide outside off. Gurbaz leaves it alone yet again.
Chivanga hits the hard length now, shaping away outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz leaves it alone for the keeper.
Tanaka Chivanga starts with a length ball, angled into the pads. Gurbaz hangs back and tucks it to the on side.
End of the first Powerplay! The fielding side can now have up to four fielders outside the 30-yard circle till the end of 40 overs. Also, the debutant, Tanaka Chivanga comes on to bowl.
A dot to end and after the first Powerplay, Afghanistan are 37/1! Fuller and on off, Rahmat Shah punches it out towards mid off.
Full and outside off, Shah shoulders arms to that one.
WIDE! Length ball, well wide of the off stump. Shah tries to fetch it but misses, wide called.
Beaten! Chatara finds the nagging length again and draws the batter forward. Shah looks to drive at it but is beaten by the movement of the ball.
This is short and wide, Gurbaz just cuts it to the right of the man at third man and picks up a run.
FOUR! Overpitched on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets his front leg out of the way and drives it straight back past the bowler for a boundary.
Uppish but in the gap! Fuller and on the pads, Rahmat Shah clips it uppishly past Ryan Burl at mid-wicket. The fielder gives the chase as the batters come back for the third.
This is angled into middle, Shah hangs back and eases it towards cover-point for a quick single.
Length ball, on the fifth stump line. Shah lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! Glorious from Rahmat Shah and that will boost the confidence a lot. Pitched up around off and just shaping in. Shah presses forward and just caresses it through extra cover for a boundary.
Just short of a length around off. Shah taps it towards cover.
Muzarabani goes full and straight this one. Shah keeps it out towards mid on.
Hard length again, on off. Rahmat Shah stays rooted in his crease as he keeps it out on the off side.
Another dot ball and it's a sedate start from Afghanistan. Back of a length, around off. Gurbaz defends it off the back foot towards covers.
This is full and on the pads, Rahmat Shah clips it away to deep square leg for a single.
Good length again but just a bit too wide to draw a shot from the batter.
A bit of shape on that one. This is outside off and Shah just shoulders arms.
Fuller and angling into the off pole. Rahmat Shah punches it out towards mid on.
Around the top of off, edged down with soft hands towards third man for a single.
Top delivery to end the over! On a nagging length, in that channel around off. The ball pitches and just zips through past the outside edge of Shah's willow.
On a good length over middle. Shah defends it back to the bowler.
Rahmat Shah comes in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Blessing Muzarabani strikes as Afghanistan lose their first. This is a bit fuller and angled onto the pads. Ibrahim Zadran looks to flick it aerially over the mid-wicket region but does so a bit too early. There's just that bit of extra bounce as well and the top edge is found. The ball pops up around short leg and Muzarabani takes a simple catch. Zimbabwe with a strong start here.
Good length, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz stabs it past backward point and collects a run.
Extra bounce again! Just a length ball, around off and the ball just pops up off the surface. Gurbaz looks to defend but is taken aback by the additional bounce and gets hit on the arm.

TWO WIDES! There's help out there for Blessing Muzarabani but once again he errs in his line. This is sprayed down the leg side and swinging further doen. Regis Chakabva does well to get a glove on it as the batters sneak in a run.
Hard length from Muzarabani, on off. Zadran hops and keeps it down on the leg side.
Another tidy over from Tendai Chatara, just the single off it. A touch fuller, nipping back in from around off. Gurbaz misses the drive and gets hit on the pads.
On a good length, angled onto the body. Rahmanullah Gurbaz just about manages to fend it away.
A juicy half-volley, around off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz fails to put it away as he drives it straight towards covers.
Length ball, around off, Gurbaz taps it towards covers.

Tight single but it's good running once again. Around the top of off, Zadran defends it gently onto the off side and sets off. The batters complete the run but if the fielder had hit, Gurbaz was a goner.
This is fuller and outside off, shaping away. Zadran has a poke at it but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Four dots in a row to end the over! Tendai Chatara continues to impress. A length ball, angled into the pads. Gurbaz tucks it to the leg side.
On a length, on off. Gurbaz stays back to blocks it out.
Length, on off, blocked out.
Back of a length, outside off, shaping away a bit. Gurbaz only manages to get an outside edge but luckily for him it lands short of the keeper.
WIDE! A sharp bouncer, on off. Gurbaz ducks under it. The umpire signals a wide.
Good length, outside off, some extra bounce this time as well. Rahmanullah Gurbaz comes down the track and swipes across the line. The ball takes the top edge and flies over the fine leg fence.
Blessing Muzarabani pitches it on a length, this time he extracts some extra bounce. The ball gets big on Gurbaz as he goes back to defend it out.
Maiden! Full length, outside off. Zadran tries to drive it on his front foot but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Five dots on the trot! Tendai Chatara has been on the money so far. Ibrahim Zadran continues to remain solid in his defence, as he deals with this length delivery on off.
Fuller, on off. Zadran drives it straight back to the bowler.
Full length, wide outside off. Zadran defends it to point.
Touch fuller, on off, blocked out.
Full length, outside off. Zadran gets on his front foot and negates it to cover.
On a length, on off, defended out solidly.
Swing and a miss! A length ball, just outside off. Gurbaz tries to block it on his front foot but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Gurbaz defends this short delivery back to the bowler.
Touch shorter, on the bodyline. Ibrahim Zadran pulls it to deep square leg for a single.

A loud appeal for lbw but turned down! Good-length delivery that nips back in sharply from outside off. Zadran stays back but fails to get any bat on it. He gets pinged on his pads, but the umpire is unmoved.
Length, on off, defended out solidly.
WIDE! A length ball, angled down leg. Zadran tries to tuck it away but misses. The keeper does well to reach it. The umpire signals a wide.
Wide outside off, Gurbaz tries to chase it but misses.
What a peach of a delivery! A length ball, this one pitches on off and shapes away, Gurbaz tries to block it out but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Good length, outside off, shaping away, Gurbaz shoulders his arms at it.
Length ball, outside off, Gurbaz leaves it alone.
A very good call in the end! A length ball, on off. Zadran hangs back and blocks it to the off side. The fielder there rushes towards it but the batters were quick to cross for a single.
Full length, wide outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz leans in and drives it through the gap at covers for three runs.
Tendai Chatara to take the other new ball from the opposite end.
Full length, on off. Zadran drives it back to the bowler but is unable to squeeze in a single.
Touch fuller, on the pads. Zadran flicks it aerially it to deep mid-wicket and collects a brace. He gets off the mark.
Fuller, on off, Zadran defends it on his front foot.
Length ball, on off, blocked out.

TWO WIDES! Some movement this time for Blessing Muzarabani. A length ball, pitching on middle and leg, it moves away down the leg side. Gurbaz tries to help it around the corner but does not get any connection. The umpire signals a wide and they collect a run as well.
Good length from Muzarabani, just outside off. Gurbaz defends it to cover.
Blessing Muzarabani starts with a length ball, right at th stumps. Rahmanullah Gurbaz stays back and blocks it out.

Done with the pre-match formalities and it's time now for the play to begin! The umpires are out in the middle and so are the Zimbabwe players. The Afghanistan opening pair of Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Ibrahim Zadran take their guard. Blessing Muzarabani has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...

We are moments away from the play beginning! But first, the two sides line up for their respective national anthems. It will be Afghanistan's national anthem first followed by the national anthem of Zimbabwe. Done with the national anthems and now Tanaka Chivanga and Innocent Kaia receive their senior national caps for Zimbabwe.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Ibrahim Zadran, Rahmat Shah, Hashmatullah Shahidi (C), Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi, Azmatullah Omarzai, Rashid Khan, Fazalhaq Farooqi, Mujeeb Ur Rahman and Fareed Ahmad.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Ryan Burl, Regis Chakabva (WK), Tendai Chatara, Tanaka Chivanga (On debut), Craig Ervine (C), Innocent Kaia (On debut), Wesley Madhevere, Blessing Muzarabani, Sikandar Raza, Milton Shumba and Donald Tiripano.
TOSS - Zimbabwe have won the toss and they will BOWL first.

Afghanistan return to international cricketing action after a 3-months break and even though they didn't win their last series against Bangladesh, the visitors will be confident of stamping their authority right from the get-go. Their talisman, Rashid Khan is coming off a title-winning campaign with Gujarat in the Indian T20 League and apart from him, they do have a pretty well-balanced side. So, which team will get that important first win in the series? We'll find out. Toss and team news in a bit.

Zimbabwe are coming off a home series defeat against fellow African side Namibia and will be looking to bounce back here. The hosts were leading the series 2-1 at one point but it all fell apart in the fifth T20I and without regulation skipper Craig Ervine the players just couldn't find any inspiration. Their bowling has been fairly consistent but it is their batting, especially their openers who need to get their team off to a good start.

Hello and a warm welcome to the first ODI between Zimbabwe and Afghanistan from the Harare Sports Club. The two teams will face each other in three ODIs and three T20Is. The hosts will be looking to put that T20I series defeat against Namibia behind them and start afresh. The visitors on the other hand will be looking to get an early advantage on the tour and start off with a win here. With 30 crucial World Cup Super League points on offer, the ODI series becomes all that more important for both sides.
